column3: Close to the Hebrew; NKJV adds “A Psalm” to the title, renders “seek refuge” as “put my trust,” and makes “as a bird” a simile.
Close to the Hebrew; “in darkness” is rendered “secretly.”
NKJV renders פַּחִים (“snares”) as “coals,” following a slight emendation of the Hebrew.
NKJV renders “the upright will see his face” as “His countenance beholds the upright,” reversing subject and object.
